name: sdd-harness-web-ykryshtopa
description: Spec-driven OpenSpec harness for web projects (Vite or Next.js): 7 automated review gates (architecture, spec, scaffold, web-qa, code+coverage merged, harness) plus a risk-triggered security/architecture deep review, an ambiguity sweep and test plan before implementation starts, architecture decision records that the architecture gate actually reads back, size-based routing, per-rule codes you can switch off individually, branch-per-group git workflow, and a scaffolder that detects your framework and package manager.
